advertisers.title: Buy native content across every Nordic title
advertisers.lead: Discovery, comparable pricing and content production in one place. Most premium editorial inventory isn't sold programmatically — we make it bookable anyway.
advertisers.problem1Body: Hundreds of titles across Norway, Sweden and Denmark, each with its own sales rep, rate card and spec sheet.
advertisers.problem2Body: Pricing lives in PDFs and emails. Comparing value across titles takes weeks of back-and-forth.
advertisers.problem3Body: Good native is editorial-grade writing tuned per publisher. Producing it in-house at quality is hard.
advertisers.solution1Body: Every newspaper and magazine that offers native, with indicative pricing, format specs and reach data — no sales call required.
advertisers.solution2Body: Submit a request to buy and our team turns it into a firm quote with the publisher. You see the price, you accept, we book.
advertisers.solution3Body: Bundled article-grade content, tuned to each title's spec and the market's disclosure rules. One supplier, better outcome.
advertisers.contentBody: Content is half the cost and most of the performance of a native campaign. Bundling it means we can ship spec-compliant, disclosure-correct articles in the lead time the publisher actually quotes — and the total bundle beats DIY.

agencies.title: A managed desk your team can lean on
agencies.lead: Plan across every Nordic title in one workspace, switch between clients in a click, and let our desk handle publisher negotiations.
agencies.feature1Body: One agency account holds every client org. Switch with one click; requests, quotes and orders stay scoped to the active client.
agencies.feature2Body: Side-by-side specs, indicative pricing and reach — built for planners, not buyers stuck in spreadsheets.
agencies.feature3Body: Where titles publish firm pricing, your planners can book instantly. Everything else routes through the desk with full transparency.
agencies.feature4Body: Surface BeNative inside your own client portals. Same catalog, your brand. Talk to us if you'd like early access.
agencies.workflowTitle: Same workflow your team already runs
agencies.workflowBody: Brief → plan → request → firm quote → order → live placement → reporting. We slot into the steps that hurt most — sourcing, quoting, content — without changing how you brief or report.
agencies.ctaBody: Open an agency workspace and add your clients. We'll set you up for a pilot RFQ within a working day.

publishersMkt.title: Incremental demand without building self-serve
publishersMkt.lead: We bring buyers who already understand native, hand you ready-to-publish content that meets your specs, and consolidate billing through one relationship.
publishersMkt.benefit1Body: Briefs that already know your format and lead time. No tire-kickers, no media-kit attachments.
publishersMkt.benefit2Body: Articles produced to your spec — word count, image counts, disclosure label, file formats. Spec-checked before it reaches you.
publishersMkt.benefit3Body: You own pricing and inventory. We never resell at a discount to your published rates; our margin is on the buyer side.
publishersMkt.benefit4Body: One invoice per cycle from BeNative across all advertisers and agencies, with payment terms you set.
publishersMkt.step1Body: We import your media kit and translate it into the BeNative catalog format. You verify; it goes live.
publishersMkt.step2Body: Advertisers and agencies find your titles, build a plan, and submit a request.
publishersMkt.step3Body: Our desk produces a firm quote; our content team writes the article to your spec. You see both before it's booked.
publishersMkt.step4Body: We hand over the asset and confirm placement. You publish, mark it confirmed, and we track it through to invoicing.
publishersMkt.controlBody: Block months you can't deliver in. Toggle products between firm-priced self-serve and managed RFQ. Update specs and lead times when your editorial team changes them. All from your publisher portal.
publishersMkt.ctaBody: We're onboarding titles across NO/SE/DK. Tell us about your inventory and we'll get back within a working day.

how.title: From brief to live placement
how.lead: Five steps from "I have a campaign idea" to a published, spec-compliant native article — most of them done by us.
how.step1Body: Filter every Nordic title by market, format, category and audience. See indicative pricing and reach up front.
how.step2Body: Add titles to a plan with budget, dates and audience notes. Compare side-by-side before you commit.
how.step3Body: Submit the plan as a request. Our desk checks availability with the publisher and produces a firm quote, usually inside a working day.
how.step4Body: Our editorial team writes the article to each title's spec — length, images, disclosure label, format — and runs a spec check before it leaves the building.
how.step5Body: The publisher books and publishes. You get the live URL, tracking and an invoice with the right VAT for your market.
how.modeFirmBody: Products with firm public pricing can be booked instantly from your plan. No desk hand-off, no quote wait.
how.modeRfqBody: Indicative-priced products go through the desk. We negotiate availability and season, then give you a firm price to accept.
how.contentBody: Per-title playbooks cover tone, length, imagery, disclosure rules (Annonsørinnhold / Annons / Annonce), and brand-safety review. An automatic spec check has to pass before an asset can be marked final — so what reaches the publisher is always publishable.

about.title: Native is operationally painful. We fix that.
about.lead: BeNative is a Nordic marketplace for buying native content and native advertising across newspapers and magazines — including the many that don't sell programmatically.
about.missionBody1: Make Nordic native inventory as easy to find, compare and buy as programmatic display — without losing the editorial quality that makes native work in the first place.
about.missionBody2: We're buyer-first: transparent catalog, transparent pricing, managed buying behind it, content production tuned to each title. Defensibility is in the dataset and the relationships, not in any single feature.
about.nordicBody: Native pays better than display in the Nordics, but the buying experience is two decades behind. Most premium titles still don't sell programmatically. Buyers and publishers both want a neutral aggregator — we're building it for NO, SE and DK first, multilingual and multi-currency from day one.
about.belief1Body: The catalog dataset and publisher relationships are the moat. Everything else is shaped around making it more complete, more accurate, more comparable.
about.belief2Body: Bad native hurts the publisher, the brand and the reader. Spec checks aren't optional and disclosure rules are encoded per market.
about.belief3Body: A managed desk only makes sense if every campaign reduces desk-hours for the next one. We instrument it so it does.
about.teamBody: A small product/engineering team in the Nordics, working alongside a buying desk and an editorial team for content production. We work in public — the platform plan, the data model and the catalog are all visible on the site.
about.contactBody: Whether you want to plan a campaign, partner as a publisher, or just compare notes on native — we'd love to hear from you.
